sn22.79:1.7: Recollecting thus, it’s only feeling that they recollect.
sn22.79:8.2: In the past I was also bitten by feeling just like now.
sn22.79:8.3: If I were to look forward to enjoying feeling in the future,
sn22.79:8.4: I’d be bitten by feeling in the future just as I am today.’
sn22.79:8.5: Reflecting like this they are not concerned with past feeling,
sn22.79:8.6: they don’t look forward to enjoying future feeling,
sn22.79:8.7: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present feeling.
sn22.79:9.3: In the past I was also bitten by choices just like now.
sn22.79:9.4: If I were to look forward to enjoying choices in the future,
sn22.79:9.5: I’d be bitten by choices in the future just as I am today.’
sn22.79:9.6: Reflecting like this they are not concerned with past choices,
sn22.79:9.7: they don’t look forward to enjoying future choices,
sn22.79:9.8: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present choices.
sn22.79:10.4: I’d be bitten by consciousness in the future just as I am today.’
